newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: One horsepower start for Vienna car auction.
newsitem.headline: One horsepower start for Vienna car auction.

text.p: Vienna's Dorotheum auction house said on Monday it was taking the unusual step of putting a horse under the hammer at a sale of vintage automobiles.
"Roberto," a 14-year-old dark brown Holstein gelding, is the first entry in the catalogue for the September 4 sale at a starting price of 6,500 schillings ($625).

The Dorotheum, established in 1785 and the world's second oldest auction house, said those wishing to size up Roberto would not find him among his fellow exhibits, such as a 1940 Opel, but in the comfort of his stable outside Vienna.
